title: Check a number in a branch
summary: Erlang: Check a number in a branch. Try a score of 3.
introduction: A guard adds a small test after a pattern. when introduces that test.
learningObjectives: Check a number in a branch with Erlang

blocks.text: Save each example as lesson.erl. Run erlc lesson.erl, then erl -noshell -s lesson main -s init stop. The file name must match the module name.
Check a number in a branch

blocks.title: Check a number in a branch
blocks.code:
-module(lesson).
-export([main/0]).
main() ->
    Score = 8,
    Message = case Score of N when N >= 5 -> "Pass"; _ -> "Try again" end,
    io:format("~s~n", [Message]).

blocks.text: The guard accepts 8 because it is at least 5.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: Not every function is allowed inside a guard.
